thesis: Large liquid-crypto moves confirmed by volume can continue for 24 to 72 hours before mean reversion dominates.
universe: native spot crypto quoted on Coinbase or Binance
trigger: Large directional move with volume confirmation and a concrete catalyst or flow mechanism.
entry_rule: Trade continuation only when code-owned spot data confirms direction and volume context.
exit_rule: Hard price invalidation, target, mechanism break, or 72-hour time stop.
sizing_hints: Use liquid spot pairs and avoid leverage assumptions.
